excerpt: An ultra-light Dobsonian made for small patios and large existential questions.
title: M42 Dobsonian
included: 3D-printed customizable optical tube assembly with non-rotating helical focuser
3D-printed dobsonian mount with altitude bearings and Teflon pads
html: The M42 Dobsonian is a stubborn wooden altar to distant light, a simple tube on a swiveling base that turns late nights into quiet negotiations with gravity and glass. Its mirrors are ground to catch photons that left home before anyone here was born, only to end their long fall on a backyard of damp grass and extension cords. No electronics beg for updates, no screens pretend to interpret the sky; just bearings that move like a slow nod and a focuser that creaks toward clarity. It does not promise answers, only slightly sharper questions etched in starlight along the edge of Orion’s shoulder. Under its weight, the universe remains just as indifferent, but at least the indifference comes into focus.
